title: Amazon Bee Frontier review: a simple $75 AI wearable that excels at always-on listening, summarizing conversations, and suggesting follow-up actions (M.G. Siegler/Spyglass)
summary: M.G. Siegler / Spyglass: Amazon Bee Frontier review: a simple $75 AI wearable that excels at always-on listening, summarizing conversations, and suggesting follow-up actions — Amazon's quiet, listening AI wearable is also pretty killer? — I'm not sure people really understand what is coming with AI and wearables.
